early_voting_window_general.reason: Pennsylvania has no early voting period. Voters can apply for and cast a mail ballot in one visit to their county election office once that county's ballots are ready, until 5 p.m. on October 27, 2026; the start date varies by county.

_measures_note: Pennsylvania has no statewide ballot measures on the November 2026 ballot. PA constitutional amendments reach voters only after the legislature passes them in two consecutive sessions, and none are scheduled for 2026. Local/municipal questions vary by county and are not yet integrated (pending a certified source).
